snippet.title: Rollerball
snippet.description:
I thought I'd make a video of my game Rollerball as I have recently ported it to the Amstrad CPC. Included here is the original ZX Spectrum version and the newly converted Amstrad CPC 464 version.
It's a simple platformer where you have to clean up the cobwebs in the time limit. It's actually quite addictive when you play it for awhile :)
Available on itchio if you want to play either version.
